title: Bring In a Bigger Mind
idiom: hand-coloured 18th-century travel-book etching, a giant testing a small maker's chair
hero_prompt: Hand-coloured etching in the manner of an 18th-century Gulliver's Travels illustration, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible etched line and watercolour texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a tiny cabinet-maker, a woman in a leather apron, standing on a workbench and holding up a freshly made wooden chair no bigger than her hand, while a giant so enormous that only his calm bearded face, one shoulder and one huge hand fit in the picture leans in from the right and presses a single fingertip on the chair's seat, testing whether it holds. Washes of ochre, slate blue and brick red.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a slate-blue ground, no shading or gradients: one enormous hand pressing a single finger down onto the seat of a small wooden chair. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
